title: Job: discover new raw files into the ledger

user_story.i_want: new raw files found every minute and recorded exactly once in a ledger
user_story.so_that: every file is processed and none twice

description: The `discover-raw-files` job lists each `raw/<stream>/` prefix with ListObjectsV2 starting after (checkpoint minus look-back). The look-back re-lists from the start of the hour before the checkpoint's hour, because a batch key uses its *open* time and slow flushes can land behind the checkpoint. Paginate, cap at N keys per run (default 1000), insert into the ledger with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING, and advance the checkpoint in the same transaction. Newly inserted rows go to STR-305. Counts go into job_runs.details.

acceptance_criteria.then: 3 ledger rows with status discovered exist and the checkpoint equals the greatest key

acceptance_criteria.given: a late file sorting before the checkpoint but inside the look-back window

acceptance_criteria.then: all 2,500 are discovered with none skipped
